discourse.title: The Best Way To Love God Is To Love All And Serve All
discourse.excerpt: Learn to speak good words. Never hurt anybody with harsh words. Speak softly and sweetly to make all people happy.
discourse.theme: Loving all begins with the tongue — speak good words, never hurt with harsh words, and speak softly and sweetly to make all happy.

reflection: Swami's convocation advice is disarmingly small: the way to love God is to love all, and loving all starts with how we speak. Today, watch one conversation — replace a harsh or careless reply with a soft, sweet one, and notice how it changes the other person. (Sri Sathya Sai Speaks, Vol 35, 22 Nov 2002)

bhajan.title: Bhajo Ghana Shyam Bhajo Sita Ram

seva_nudge: Serve one person today in a practical way — help an elderly neighbour with shopping or a chore, and do it as service to God in that person.
